issues.title: Unresolved External Script Dependencies
issues.why: The spec mandates execution of multiple scripts (e.g., linter-scripts/check-spec-folder-refs.py, check-tree-health.cjs) to verify the module, but these scripts are not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Include the source code or detailed logic/interfaces for all referenced linter-scripts in the spec tree.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'On-Disk' Resolution Logic
issues.why: AC-RESEARCH-07 requires resolving domain strings against the 'repo's spec/ tree', but does not define the root path or how to handle symlinks/case-sensitivity in the resolution logic.
issues.fix: Define the base path for resolution (e.g., project root) and specify case-sensitive matching for the kebab-case regex.

issues.title: Registry Table Type Mismatch
issues.why: The SQL DDL uses 'TEXT' for AuthoredAt, while the Validation Schema excerpt expects 'date-time' format; the SQL lacks a CHECK constraint to enforce this format.
issues.fix: Add a CHECK constraint to the RegistryEntry table: CHECK (AuthoredAt IS datetime(AuthoredAt)).
